latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI Christmas photo generator skill.
- Instantly transform a portrait into a festive Christmas scene using AI.
- Supports uploading a portrait image and customizing the Christmas atmosphere.
- Output images feature vintage film style and Y2K influences, with detailed festive settings.
- Requires a WeShop API key and HTTPS access to openapi.weshop.ai.
- Provides endpoints for initiating image runs, polling status, and uploading images.
